subject: Clarify billing entity & tax docs for multi-entity marketplace bookings (Acme)
messages:
From: AWS Marketplace Billing <aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: accounting@aws-partner.amazon.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace invoice entity + tax docs required for upcoming November charges

Marcus —

Hope you're well. We are reconciling November marketplace charges for listings where AWS acts as Seller-of-Record and need confirmation of the invoicing entity and tax documentation for the Acme Analytics orders on file. Specifically we need the following by EOD Nov 30 to avoid a delay in invoice issuance:

- For US-domiciled customers: current W-9 for the billed entity (EIN and legal name).
- For non-US buyers (EU/UK): VAT registration number or confirmation to treat the transaction under reverse-charge (include VAT cert where applicable).
- For reseller/co-sell bookings: signed reseller certificate or proof of reseller authorization if Redwood is acting as reseller for any portion of the billing.

We attached our standard invoicing guidance (AWS_Marketplace_Invoicing_Instructions.pdf) which explains when AWS invoices the end customer vs when the SaaS vendor or reseller is the billing party. At present we have mixed signals for Acme — some charges flowed through AWS marketplace in EU, others were handled as private offers where Redwood invoiced directly. Please confirm per-invoice entity mapping and provide the docs above.

Also note VAT handling differs by region — if Acme expects reverse-charge in the EU, we need the VAT ID to annotate the invoice; otherwise VAT may be applied by the marketplace.

Thanks — ping if you'd like a short call.

--
AWS Marketplace Billing Team
attachments: AWS_Marketplace_Invoicing_Instructions.pdf (pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace invoice entity + tax docs required for upcoming November charges

Marissa / Ben — forwarding the AWS request below. Short summary: Acme has purchases that landed in three different flows last quarter: (1) AWS SOR EU bookings for Acme EU Ltd, (2) direct Redwood invoices for some marketing credits (US entity), and (3) private-offer arrangements where AWS collects monies but passes through invoices to Acme in their portal.

I attached a quick entity matrix that maps Acme orders to legal entities (Entity_overview_table.xlsx). Can you confirm the following by EOD Monday so I can reply to AWS and attach the proper paperwork?

- Confirm which orders AWS should invoice directly (provide marketplace order IDs or date ranges).
- Provide Acme's VAT ID for the EU entity and a copy of any VAT registration certificate.
- Confirm we have a current W-9 for Acme US purchases (if invoices were billed to Acme Inc).
- If Redwood acted as reseller/partner for any of these orders, attach the signed reseller certificate (we may need to sign a vendor-specific form for AWS).

If anything is unclear, we can jump on a 20-min sync with AWS billing.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Head of GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
attachments: Entity_overview_table.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 08:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Marketplace invoice entity + tax docs required for upcoming November charges

Marcus —

Quick answers and attachments below (see attached Acme_EU_VAT_cert.pdf and W9_Acme_US.pdf):

- EU marketplace bookings: These were placed under Acme EU Ltd (VAT: EU123456789). We have the VAT registration cert attached and request AWS apply reverse-charge on supplier invoices where applicable.
- US bookings: Acme Inc (EIN: 12-3456789) — W-9 on file (attached).
- Reseller/co-sell: For two private-offer transactions in Sept/Oct, Redwood acted as value-added reseller for additional services. We have a signed reseller certificate in our records, but AWS requires their vendor form. I attached the internal summary of which PO/order IDs map to the reseller arrangement (see Entity_overview_table.xlsx row highlights).

Notes: For the EU items, please confirm AWS will annotate the invoice with Acme EU's VAT number and mark the invoice for reverse charge. Where AWS is Seller-of-Record we expect them to issue the invoice directly to Acme and copy our accounting for reconciliation. For private offers where Redwood invoiced, we will provide invoices to Acme and coordinate VAT treatment on our side.

Attachments: Acme_EU_VAT_cert.pdf, W9_Acme_US.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: AWS Marketplace Billing <aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com>, Acme Finance <invoices@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, accounting@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace invoice entity + tax docs required for upcoming November charges — consolidated response

Hi team —

Thanks for the patience while we pulled docs together. Below is the consolidated mapping and attached paperwork to satisfy marketplace invoicing requirements. Please confirm receipt and whether AWS needs any additional vendor-specific forms.

Mapping (invoice routing & tax docs):
- Order IDs in AWS portal dated 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-10: AWS SOR (EU) — Bill to Acme EU Ltd (VAT: EU123456789). Attached: Acme_EU_VAT_cert.pdf. Please apply reverse-charge and issue invoice directly to invoices@acme-analytics.com; cc accounting@redwood.com for reconciliation.
- Order IDs dated 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-20: Direct Redwood invoice (US) — Bill to Acme Inc (EIN: 12-3456789). Attached: W9_Acme_US.pdf. Redwood will issue those invoices and account for US sales tax where applicable.
- Private-offer transactions (Sept/Oct) flagged in Entity_overview_table.xlsx: Redwood acted as reseller for value-added services. Attached: Redwood_reseller_certificate_signed.pdf (signed). If AWS requires their vendor-specific reseller form, please share the link and we'll complete it.

Tax handling notes:
- EU VAT: We request AWS annotate SOR invoices with Acme EU's VAT number and use reverse-charge. If AWS applies VAT on the invoice, please send a draft so we can confirm whether Acme will claim credit or if we need to re-route.
- US tax: W-9 attached; no US withholding expected for these SaaS subscriptions.

Attachments included: Entity_overview_table.xlsx, Acme_EU_VAT_cert.pdf, W9_Acme_US.pdf, Redwood_reseller_certificate_signed.pdf

Next steps requested from AWS:
1) Confirm which invoices you will issue directly to Acme (provide invoice numbers/dates) and whether VAT will be applied or reversed.
2) If AWS needs a reseller/vendor-specific form for Redwood, send the URL and contact person.
3) Provide any marketplace invoice PDFs that are pending issuance for the November window so Acme can reconcile with their AP team.

Acme — please confirm receipt of the invoices once AWS issues them so we can close the loop on reconciliation.

If helpful, I can set a 20-minute call Thursday with AWS billing + Acme AP to clear any remaining items.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Head of GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
attachments: Entity_overview_table.xlsx, Acme_EU_VAT_cert.pdf, W9_Acme_US.pdf, Redwood_reseller_certificate_signed.pdf
